title: Quietly Velvety Spanish Romano Pepper Paella Valenciana
description: A comforting Spanish dish featuring Romano peppers, this paella is peppery, velvety, and made with ayurvedic sattvic friendly ingredients, cooked to perfection in a wood fired bake, in the traditional Valenciana style.
instructions: Preheat the wood fired oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the Romano peppers into large pieces and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoked paprika and salt, and stir to combine.
Add the Arborio rice and stir to coat the rice in the oil and mix with the spices.
Add the water and lemon juice, and bring to a boil.
Add the Romano peppers and stir to combine.
Transfer the paella pan to the preheated wood fired oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the paella from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
